package khipu

import (
	"context"
	"slices"
)

// FlowCheckpoint is an E2-only ordinary-break checkpoint. Its preparation and
// copied boundary list cannot be rebound to another owner. No elastic planes escape.
type FlowCheckpoint struct {
	owner    *Khipukamayuq
	prepared *PreparedParagraph
	prefix   []int
}

// FlowSupported deliberately excludes all discretionary policies from E2.
func (p *PreparedParagraph) FlowSupported(owner *Khipukamayuq) bool {
	return p != nil && p.owner == owner && p.hyphenation == NoHyphenation
}

// FlowCheckpointFor captures already chosen ordinary boundaries. Typography
// supplies the prefix of a successfully frozen initial path, not source offsets.
func (q *Khipukamayuq) FlowCheckpointFor(ctx context.Context, p *PreparedParagraph, prefix []int) (*FlowCheckpoint, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		return nil, ErrIllegalArguments
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if q == nil || p == nil || p.owner != q {
		return nil, ErrIllegalArguments
	}
	if !p.FlowSupported(q) {
		return nil, ErrUnsupportedPolicy
	}
	prev := -1
	for _, at := range prefix {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if at <= prev || at >= len(p.knots) || p.knots[at].Penalty >= MaxPenalty {
			return nil, ErrIllegalArguments
		}
		for i := prev + 1; i < at; i++ {
			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if p.knots[i].Penalty <= MaxMerit {
				return nil, ErrIllegalArguments
			}
		}
		prev = at
	}
	return &FlowCheckpoint{q, p, slices.Clone(prefix)}, nil
}

// FlowPrefix validates ownership without rescanning the prepared prefix. Only
// the small boundary list is copied; checkpoint creation performs knot validation.
func (q *Khipukamayuq) FlowPrefix(ctx context.Context, p *PreparedParagraph, c *FlowCheckpoint) ([]int, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		return nil, ErrIllegalArguments
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if q == nil || c == nil || c.owner != q || c.prepared != p || p == nil || p.owner != q {
		return nil, ErrIllegalArguments
	}
	return slices.Clone(c.prefix), nil
}

// FlowNoHyphenation prevents a breaker entry from assuming absent replacement carry.
func (k *Khipu) FlowNoHyphenation() bool {
	return k != nil && k.owner != nil && k.hyphenationPolicy && k.hyphenation == NoHyphenation
}

// FlowWork counts actual visits to the existing binding/materialization loops.
// The trace is invocation-local and follows the owner's serialized-use contract.
type FlowWork struct{ Bound, BoundPrefix, Materialized, MaterializedPrefix int }
type flowTrace struct {
	end  int
	work *FlowWork
}
type flowTraceKey struct{}

// FlowTraceContext installs invocation-local instrumentation for E2.
func FlowTraceContext(ctx context.Context, end int, work *FlowWork) context.Context {
	return context.WithValue(ctx, flowTraceKey{}, flowTrace{end, work})
}
func flowBound(ctx context.Context, i int) {
	if t, ok := ctx.Value(flowTraceKey{}).(flowTrace); ok {
		t.work.Bound++
		if i <= t.end {
			t.work.BoundPrefix++
		}
	}
}
func flowMaterialized(ctx context.Context, i int) {
	if t, ok := ctx.Value(flowTraceKey{}).(flowTrace); ok {
		t.work.Materialized++
		if i <= t.end {
			t.work.MaterializedPrefix++
		}
	}
}
